author: 1Stalk
quote:
I expected Rockstar to deliver something like Natural Born Killers a genuinely wild, unhinged outlaw couple dealing with real, heavy moral choices. Instead, we got an extremely boring, woke dating simulator. The main characters have zero charisma, and every character in the story makes stupid decisions. The plot isn't fun at all, and I played the entire game with a straight face.

Gameplay wise, the game is way too restrictive. You literally can't kill certain NPCs in the open world because of moral limits, and you aren't even allowed to pick up hookers as Jason or Lucia. Past Rockstar games always had one simple principle: the player decides their own morality. Here, it is forced on you, and it feels shameful.

In the end, the only emotions I got from this game were boredom, disappointment, and shame.
